notes.title: Version 1.15.0 - Bridges
notes.content: [p]Features:[/p][list][*][p]Added Bridges[/p][list][*][p]All Nations can place Bridges to span small rivers[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Gameplay:[/p][list][*][p]Mines only have one level of Ores unlocked for the Lvl 1 Mine[/p][list][*][p]Upgrading Mines allows higher level Ores to be prospected once they are unlocked[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated the collision between units in formations so they do not pass through each other as often[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the damage-taken animation feedback so the animations play more frequently[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the base audio volume[/p][/*][*][p]Added more sounds during battles[/p][/*][*][p]More audio tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the Depth-Of-Field effect[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]UI:[/p][list][*][p]Display the number of early-build-resources, food, and prospected ores on the UI[/p][/*][*][p]Add a thank you message[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Bug-fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed moving the mouse Left/Up behaving differently from Right/Down (thanks Clay)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by changing the Nation for a level in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the performance when paused[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some cases where buildings failed to upgrade because of terrain[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.14.1 - The Demo
notes.content: [p]Features:[/p][list][*][p]Added the Plebs Demo version[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Gameplay:[/p][list][*][p]Slightly increased the size of some terrain models[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced the size of unit health icons[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased keyboard pan speed[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked some camera settings[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]UI:[/p][list][*][p]Added a button on the main menu to WIshlist from the Demo[/p][/*][*][p]Added a button on the main menu to a feedback form from the Demo[/p][/*][*][p]Update the Survival UI to match the Skirmish player setup[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Bug-fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Resolved some cases where the direction of formations was calculated incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some Vehicles UI incorrectly showing an icon to unload units[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed changing the Agro mode of vehicles not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an infrequent crash when group selecting Champion units[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.14.0 - Map Generator
notes.content: [p]Features:[/p][list][*][p]Added Windowed Fullscreen (Borderless) display mode[/p][list][*][p]Windowed Fullscreen is now the default display mode[/p][/*][*][p]In Windowed Fullscreen the game resolution always matches the monitor's resolution[/p][/*][*][p]The 'Fullscreen' setting has been replaced with 'Display Mode'[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added a Map Generator[/p][list][*][p]In 'Skirmish' game mode, the 'Generate' button opens a menu to generate a new random map[/p][/*][*][p]You can control the type of land, the size of the map, the 'climate', and whether the map should be mirrored[/p][/*][*][p]Each map has a 'seed' so that all generated maps are unique[/p][/*][*][p]The generated map will have a number of enemy player positions, depending on the size of the map. Each player can be individually be selected, and their Nation changed [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Formations can now have their unit-order changed[/p][list][*][p]By default units are not ordered[/p][/*][*][p]Formations can be ordered by attack ranges[/p][/*][*][p]Formations can be ordered by strength (based on the units weapon Metal)[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicles are always at the back of the formation[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Created a short Steam guide for each nation[/p][list][*][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3507833997"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hungry workers for a number of buildings will now work slower[/p][/*][*][p]Units with 'Attack' based Metals have slightly larger weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Units with 'Defence' based Metals have slightly larger shields[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Gameplay:[/p][list][*][p]Plebs no longer take too much food to houses when Plebs have become soldiers and no longer live in that house[/p][/*][*][p]Improved unit movement around buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of time Miners take to produce Ore slightly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]UI:[/p][list][*][p]The map player configuration window has been updated[/p][list][*][p]Removed unnecessary text and replaced interactions with icons that can be clicked[/p][/*][*][p]Each player has a larger building icon, which can be clicked to change the Nation[/p][/*][*][p]For generated maps each player will have players disabled by default, which can be enabled by clicking on the player + icon[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Farms growing crops now show any icon when it is waiting for them to grow[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Worker allocation tool icon not applying a metal colour[/p][/*][*][p]Allow for longer save file names[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Bug-fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a number of cases where objects where shown through the Fog-of-War briefly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some save files failing to load[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed trees using the wrong terrain colouring[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed not being able to target enemies with the Egyptian Chariot[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when returning to the main menu when projectiles are flying[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped towers firing projectiles displaying incorrect particles[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved farm crops appearing to start fully grown[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loading roads from maps[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved some land-spikes not being created or highlighted correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some occasional stuttering[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.13.0 - Units & Armour
notes.content: [p]Features:[/p][list][*][p]Added new units for each Nation:[/p][list][*][p]Greek Phalangite - Weakly armoured soldier who uses a Sarissa. Strong against weakly armoured enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Norsemen Shield-maiden - Highly armoured warrior that will charge at enemies causing extra damage. Strong against highly armoured enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Egyptian Slinger - A weakly armoured and hastily trained soldier with a Sling, deadly in large numbers. Strong against highly armoured enemies[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All unit attacks have a 'Category' which specifies how strong they are against different levels of armour[/p][list][*][p]Piercing attacks are great against weakly armoured units[/p][/*][*][p]Concussive attacks are great against strong armoured units[/p][/*][*][p]Destructive attacks are great against buildings[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All units now have an 'Armour' level which defines how well they defend against different types of attack[/p][list][*][p]Strong/High armour is strong against Piercing attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Medium armour is reasonably strong against all attack types[/p][/*][*][p]Weak/Low armour is string against Concussive attacks[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All unit descriptions have been updated to reflect their armour level and their offensive strengths (i.e. the armour level they are highly effective against)[/p][/*][*][p]Each unit's weapon/armour metal colour and level is displayed under the units health when selected[/p][/*][*][p]Vastly improved the Tutorial[/p][list][*][p]All tutorial steps have expanded descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]There are now 3 Tutorial challenges to complete[/p][list][*][p]Each challenge contains hints for the current Nation[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Icons display the expected mouse interaction to perform the tutorial action[/p][/*][*][p]When the tutorial step list is completed a sound is played[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved some step/action inconsistencies[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All animations will now smoothly blend from the previous animation[/p][/*][*][p]Added unique animations for each direction units take damage from[/p][/*][*][p]Units and buildings being healed display a short animation[/p][/*][*][p]When moving a building's harvest area, the cursor is changed to indicate when the area can be moved[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing building upgrade models for some buildings[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Gameplay:[/p][list][*][p]Added Greek Spearsmith Workshop[/p][list][*][p]Spearsmiths produce Spears from 1 Ingot[/p][/*][*][p]Spearsmiths produce 2x Sarissa from 1x Ingot and 1x Log[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Greek Phalangite[/p][list][*][p]Phalangite are trained at the Stratopedon and require 1x Sarissa[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Norsemen Shield-maiden[/p][list][*][p]Shield-maiden are trained at the Viking Camp and require 1x Round Shield and 1x Bearded Axe[/p][/*][*][p]Shield-maiden's 'Round Shield' are produced by Carpenters[/p][list][*][p]Carpenters produce 2x Round Shields from 1x Ingot and 1x Log[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Egyptians Slinger[/p][list][*][p]Slingers are trained at the Armoury and require 1x Sling[/p][/*][*][p]Slinger's Sling are produced by Blacksmiths[/p][list][*][p]Blacksmiths produce 1x Sling from 1x Sling Stone[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Egyptian Sling Stones are produced by Stonecutters[/p][list][*][p]Stonecutters produce 4x Sling Stones from 1x Rock[/p][/*][*][p]Pick between producing Sling Stones or Talatat from the Stonecutter's building window[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removed Egyptians Kiln[/p][list][*][p]Shadoof now requires Adobe Brick instead of Olla[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]UI:[/p][list][*][p]Add a tooltip to the Mine Attack/Defence selection[/p][/*][*][p]Removed repeated notifications on defeat[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Levels:[/p][list][*][p]A number of small changes to all levels[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Bug-fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed some cases where buildings would stop being built[/p][/*][*][p]Stop vehicles that are being constructed from attacking enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved not being able to target enemy Chariots[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved units attacking the unit within Chariots instead of the Chariot itself[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Masonry harvesting the same sand repeatedly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed save games with '-' in the name not saving[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some crashes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed particles sometimes being shown incorrectly[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.12.0 - Level Nations
notes.content:
Features:
[list]
[*] You can now pick which Nation to play as for all survival maps
[*] You can now pick the Nation to play as, and the Nation for the opponents, for a number of skirmish maps
[*] Added land spikes for all touching land when the land is contested by multiple Towers
[*] Veteran champions now slowly heal all units within their radius
[/list]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Improved the alignment of animations to the movement of Plebs
[*] Improved the animation of projectiles
[*] Improved unit blocking so Plebs do not have to wait behind each other as often
[*] Improved a number of movement avoidance cases with Plebs waiting forever or moving into buildings
[*] Unit formations will only wait in formation at the start and end of their movement, allowing them to move faster
[*] Greek Spartans have a slower attack speed and damage, but higher health and defence
[*] Towers are slightly stronger
[*] Slightly lowered the 'Durability' Metal Skill threshold
[*] If Plebs cannot reach a building for a while, a notification is shown to warn the player
[*] Improved the alignment of the fog-of-war
[/list]

Performance:
[list]
[*] Sped up returning to the main menu and quitting the game
[*] Various performance improvements
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] For survival the chosen stratagem icons are shown under the minimap
[*] When picking a stratagem, the enemy units that will attack in the next wave are shown on the UI
[*] Improved the Mine UI prospect slider animations
[*] Fixed 'Victory' notifications being shown repeatedly after winning
[/list]

Levels:
[list]
[*] Added the option to select the starting nation for the player and for opponents for a number of levels
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed some cases where Towers could be placed in contested land
[*] Fixed Plebs playing the wrong animation when queuing behind other Plebs
[*] Added missing upgrade models for a number of buildings
[*] Added Egyptian Chariot death animation
[*] Egyptian warrior torch throw animation sounds are no longer delayed
[*] Fixed Plebs sometimes not changing elevation when walking over hills and dips
[*] Fixed fog-of-war for buildings being upgraded not being restored from save files
[*] Fixed some cases where units would not attack vehicles
[*] Fixed a crash when cancelling a worker allocation if there isn't an assigned Pleb
[*] Stop Farms from causing other terrain to be removed
[*] Fixed buildings not being shown when fog-of-war was cleared in some cases
[*] Sometimes attacking units in fog-of-war would stay hidden
[*] Fixed soldiers jumping around when targetting a tower to garrison multiple times in a row
[*] Units that are training or being constructed are not added to formations
[*] Stop soldiers from attacking units that have garrisoned
[*] Fixed a crash when targetting a vehicle to Ruins
[*] Fixed upgrading the Citadel causing the number of free Plebs to be wrong
[*] A number of other stability changes and crash fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.11.0 - Survival Mode
notes.content:
Features:
[list]
[*] Added 'Survival mode'
[list]
[*] In Survival mode waves of enemies will attack your town. You will need to continually build up your defences with soldiers, vehicles, Champions, walls, and everything else at your disposal to stay alive as long as possible
[*] Each wave brings a bigger challenge than the last, with 'Battle' waves providing an even greater threat to your town
[*] You can pick 'Stratagems' which aid your town, your Plebs, and your army
[list]
[*] Stratagems come in a wide variety, for example faster movement over roads, unlocking Metals more quickly, strengthening your Towers, and many many more
[*] You will be able to select a Stratagem at the beginning of the level and periodically after successfully defending against waves of enemies
[*] Rewards will also be given to you to provide smaller boosts to your town, such as a number of free Plebs, or even a free Champion of your choosing
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Architect Champions will slowly restore the health of buildings within their radius
[*] Champion Palaces now have a cooldown before a new Champion can be selected
[*] Increased metal durability slightly
[*] Increased all soldier training duration
[*] New soldiers will not start training at the armoury until there is a free training area
[*] All armoury buildings start with one training area. Further training areas are added when upgraded
[*] Increased the resource cost of some buildings slightly
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] Redesigned the main menu
[*] Added 'Survival mode' to the main menu
[*] Added a button to building notifications to quickly re-assign a new worker when their tool degrades
[*] Added the Egyptian 'Stables' building option
[/list]

Levels:
[list]
[*] Added Survival mode maps:
[list]
[*] Encircled
[*] Level Up
[*] Nowhere To Hide
[/list]
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed building resources being destroyed when buildings are upgraded
[*] Fixed the Codex not loading the Player's Nation when first opened
[*] Fixed miners not calculating the amount of prospect correctly when changing the mine trait
[*] Stopped units from being pushed up hills or onto water when avoiding/colliding/being knocked back
[*] Fixed loading saves with Champions
[*] Stopped all buildings producing notifications when the Player is defeated
[*] Resolved units in vehicles (e.g. chariots) remaining invisible when exiting the Fog of War
[*] Resolved the 'new Champion' notification spamming
[*] Various crash fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.10.0 - Codex Plebis
notes.content:
Features:
[list]
[*] Added the 'Codex Plebis' which displays all of the resources that each building produces and consumes for each Nation
[list]
[*] The Codex can be used as a guide for deciding which buildings to construct
[*] The Codex can be opened from a new icon next to the Minimap
[/list]
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] Improved the grouping and ordering of the buildings in the bottom construction menu to make it easier to use
[*] Fixed a number of issues with the Campaign UI at 4k
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Improved alt-tabbing when Fullscreen
[*] Fixed switching Fullscreen on and off breaking the UI
[*] Fixed VSync picking the wrong frame-rate
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.9.0 - Statues & Monuments
notes.content:
Features:
[list]
[*] Added Statues and Monuments which buff Plebs & Buildings in the town
[list]
[*] Greek Pleb Statue - Plebs will construct and upgrade buildings within its radius 50% faster
[*] Greek Spartan Statue - Buildings within its radius have 20% higher defence
[*] Greek Goddess Statue - Lumberjacks and Masons within its radius have 20% decreased regeneration cost each time they are harvested
[*] Norse Battle Runestone - Borg within its radius have 20% stronger attack
[*] Norse Prayer Runestone - Lumberjacks and Masons within its radius can re-harvest 20% faster
[*] Norse Memorial Runestone - Workers in its radius will work 20% faster
[*] Egyptian Obelisk - Increases the number of Plebs produced by Houses within its radius by 2, when built or upgraded
[*] Egyptian Sphinx - Speeds up the growth of Horses in Stables within its radius by 30%
[*] Egyptian Pharaoh Statue - Plebs within its radius are 50% less affected by hunger
[/list]
[*] Crafting many Tools & Weapons from the same Metal unlocks skills that improve those Tools & Weapons further
[list]
[*] Crafting 100 unlocks Durability - all Worker Tools will last forever and do not need replacing
[*] Crafting 150 unlocks Piercing - all Soldiers & Vehicles deal much greater damage to highly armoured enemies
[*] Crafting 200 unlocks Resistance - all Soldiers & Vehicles receive much lower damage from stronger enemies
[/list]
[*] All Tools without 'Durability' will now degrade over time, makeshift tools degrade the quickest, higher quality metals take longer to degrade
[/list]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Greatly increased upgraded Towers attack and fire-rates
[*] All upgraded Towers require more resources to construct
[*] Increased the damage of Egyptian Warriors in Chariots
[*] All war vehicles can attack both soldiers and buildings
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] Slightly re-ordered some Buildings in the Building selection lists
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the Picaxe sound being played over the whole map
[*] Corrected the amount of Sand that Egyptians Masons could harvest within their area
[*] Fixed some buildings requesting the wrong number of resources when building multiple units or vehicles
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.8.0 - Campaign Overworld
notes.content:
Features:
[list]
[*] Added the 'Campaign overworld map'
[list]
[*] Campaign levels are selected by clicking on the map and moving your character to a Banner, which displays the level details
[*] Completing a level will unlock the next level for that campaign, and with enough completed levels, other campaigns are also unlocked
[*] The campaign can be played-through at any difficulty, but completing a level will only unlock the next level for the completed difficulty and lower difficulties. E.g. Completing a level at the 'Pleb' difficulty will unlock the next level for both 'Pleb' difficulty and 'Casual' difficulty, but will remain locked for the 'Commander' difficulty
[/list]
[*] Updated the title music
[*] Updated the in-game music
[/list]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Roads can now be placed at any angle, making it easier to create more complex road networks
[*] Roads are slightly smaller
[*] The resources needed to create a Road for all Nations are now easier to gather
[list]
[*] Increased the number of Sandstone Bricks harvested by the Egyptian Mason from 1 to 4
[*] Increased the number of Stone Bricks crafted by the Greek Brickmaker from 3 to 5
[*] Increased the number of Timber crafted by the Norsemen Carpenters from 3 to 5
[/list]
[*] Removed Hammer And Chisel from Egyptians, fully replaced with Adze
[*] Changed Norsemen Longship resources to require Nails instead of Ingots
[*] Changed some building resource requirements for all Nations
[/list]

Performance:
[list]
[*] Improved the compression for all audio
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] All Resources in all Buildings now display a description when hovering
[*] Updated the descriptions of many Resources, Buildings, and Vehicles
[*] Selecting a save-file displays if the level is part of a Campaign
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed fire being incorrectly shown behind the fog-of-war
[*] Fixed cases where UI icons were not changing correctly
[*] Corrected a few cases where objects were being rotated incorrectly
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7.0 - Bounties & Balance
notes.content:
Features:
[list]
[*] Added Building Ruins & 'Bounties'
[list]
[*] Soldiers can search Ruins to discover bounties which, when returned to the Town, will provide resources, information, or other goodies which will help your Plebs!
[*] Soldiers holding a bounty will show a Treasure Chest above them
[*] If a Soldier is killed when holding a Bounty, the Bounty is lost
[*] Added Help page for Ruins & Bounties
[*] Added Tutorial step for Ruins & Bounties
[*] Bounties which are returned to the Town will provide a random bonus which will help your town grow faster
[/list]
[*] All Plebs (even those working in buildings) now require food each night to satisfy their hunger and keep working at full speed
[list]
[*] Plebs that do not have a House at the start of the level are assigned to the first House built
[*] Reduced the amount that Plebs gain hunger each night
[/list]
[*] Added Level and Campaign difficulty levels
[list]
[*] There are three difficulty levels to choose from when playing a level or campaign
[*] Individual Campaign maps can be selected so they can be replayed at a different difficulty
[*] If Victorious in a level or campaign, the difficulty it was completed at will be shown next to the level name
[*] In Peaceful mode, Terrain regrowth duration does not increase each time they are harvested
[/list]
[*] Damage from Towers can slow units for a short time
[*] Towers with Garrisoned units show a Shield icon above them
[*] Added Greek Xiphos sword model
[/list]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Many improvements to animations during battles to make them more active
[*] Generally improved animation alignment
[*] Improved projectiles during battles
[*] General balancing changes to each nation's soldiers
[*] Changed the damage calculations to reduce 1-damage attacks and remove the frequency of very-long-lasting fights
[*] Each nation now has unique 'hurt' sounds
[*] Add Priority selection for Producer input resources
[*] Display the area Support buildings will support when placed
[*] Display the area for Producer buildings that are boosted by Water
[*] Worker Pleb allocation can now be cancelled
[*] Slightly reduced the land radius of all Citadel buildings
[*] Units in a formation will spread apart when they stop moving
[*] Greek House lvl 3 requires Stone Bricks
[*] Egyptian House lvl 3 requires Talatat
[*] Replaced Norsemen Hammer & Chisel with Handsaws
[/list]

Performance:
[list]
[*] On player defeat, only Towers create explosions
[*] Removed the delay when selecting levels and campaigns
[*] Add vehicle models to death timeout
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] Add a 'Return to Main Menu' button to the Victory/Defeat screen
[*] The default livery can be selected in the Settings
[*] Added UI for Producer buildings
[*] Added UI for Support buildings
[*] Display in the UI when Harvesters and Farmers are waiting for input resource or on cooldown
[*] Added notification for Plebs who have been hungry for multiple days
[/list]

Levels:
[list]
[*] Updated the location of Building Ruins for all levels
[*] Balance changes for a number of levels
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Ensure Soldiers will attack back if they are attacked, and not otherwise attacking another unit
[*] Attached arrows were often in the wrong place
[*] Fixed occasional crash on Victory
[*] Fixed a crash moving building ghosts while the game is paused
[*] Ensure completing a level is shown immediately on the level selection page
[*] Fixed changing a Mine's focus losing current prospect progress
[*] Fixed AI players creating invalid unit formations
[*] Fixed Producers only requesting one resource at a time
[*] Projectiles incorrectly oriented when the target is at a different elevation
[*] Added missing Spartan throw animation
[*] Placing Producer building did not clear the range circle
[*] In-progress building fires jumps around
[*] Stopped chariots from being movable while being built
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.6.0 - The Egyptians
notes.content:
Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Added the Egyptians Nation
[list][*] Egyptians primarily use Adobe Bricks for constructing buildings, and higher level buildings can be created with Sandstone from the new Sand terrain type
[*] The Egyptian Plebs are fed with Bataw bread and Zythum beer. Both require growing Wheat, which must be milled into Grain
[*] Egyptian Chariots are the perfect units for quickly scouting areas and causing damage where the enemy may not be expecting an attack[/list]
[*] Units can be attached to Vehicles
[*] Increased Citadel health
[*] Towers have a basic attack when there are no Sentry units
[*] Add a 'Message History' window, opened with the button found on the bottom-right, or the 'M' keyboard key
[*] The minimap is always centred on the discovered area of the map
[*] Added building upgrade descriptions, shown when hovering on the upgrade button for each building
[/list]

Features:
[list]
[*] Added the 'Sand' terrain type
[list]
[*] Greeks and Norsemen travel slower over Sand
[*] Egyptians can harvest Sandstone Bricks from Sand terrain
[/list]
[*] Added 'Support' Buildings
[list]
[*] Support buildings buff nearby buildings in the town
[*] Support buildings do not require a Pleb
[*] The Egyptian 'Irrigation' support building improves the growth speed of nearby 'Wheat Farms'
[/list]
[*] Added farming of Animals
[list]
[*] The Egyptian 'Stables' building requires a Horse to produce Tamed Horses
[*] Tamed Horses can be used to product Chariots
[/list]
[*] Added Vehicle unit attacking
[/list]

Performance:
[list]
[*] Improved Harvester terrain searching performance
[/list]

Levels:
[list]
[*] Added the Egyptians Campaign
[*] Added the 'Roundabout' level
[*] Added the 'Trench' level
[*] 'Target Practice' Player 5 is now Egyptians
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Improved Plebs walking over Roads more smoothly and always receiving the movement boost
[*] Resolved building worker requests getting lost if the Pleb cannot initially reach it
[*] Resolved a case where units would be blocked from picking up resources at a building
[*] Fixed Refiner buildings that do not require a Metal not finding the input resource
[*] Renamed Safe mode to Peaceful mode
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.5.1 - Small bug-fixes
notes.content:
Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed rendering issue caused by changing Shadow quality from the Main Menu (thanks Apollo)
[*] Additional logging improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.5.0 - Opponents
notes.content:
Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Display the 'inputs' and 'outputs' for each building that produces resources in the tooltips
[*] Added Tutorial steps for Makeshift tools
[/list]

Features:
[list]
[*] Added AI 'Opponents' (named AI with personalities)
[list]
[*] Each opponent has a 'personality' which changes how they expand their town, build their army, and attack other opponents
[*] Greeks and Norsemen both have four named AI Opponents
[/list]
[/list]

Performance:
[list]
[*] Reduced the size of large audio files
[/list]

Levels:
[list]
[*] Set specific AI Opponents for a number of levels
[*] Levels with no AI Opponent set will have a random opponent, chosen when the level is started
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Resolved the game window & UI not displaying correctly when Windows 'Display Scaling' is above 100%
[*] Fixed the game not fully closing properly
[*] Fixed the Tutorial not displaying correctly if opened a second time
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.4.1 - Small bug-fixes
notes.content:
Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when a worker is converted back to a Pleb and their building is destroyed
[*] Disabled Safe-Mode for Campaign maps
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.4.0 - Champions
notes.content:
Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Added the Champion unit
[list]
[*] Champions are special units that provide boosts to your army or town.
[*] Each Champion can be created at a 'Champion Palace' building and can only be built once their requirements are met.
[*] Multiple 'Champion Palaces' can be built, but each can only create one Champion at a time.
[/list]
[*] Added the Veteran Champion
[list]
[*] A Veteran requires a certain number of enemy units to be killed.
[*] The Veteran will boost your armies strength, all soldiers within the Veteran's radius have increased defence and attack.
[/list]
[*] Added the Merchant Champion
[list]
[*] A Merchant requires a certain number of resources to be produced in your town.
[*] The Merchant will boost your worker's efficiency, all workers within the Merchant's radius will work faster.
[/list]
[*] Added the Architect Champion
[list]
[*] An Architect requires a certain number of buildings to be built in your town.
[*] The Architect will boost expanding your town, all buildings within the Architect's radius will be built faster.
[/list]
[*] Added the Champion Palace building
[list]
[*] Greeks can place the Anaktoro building to create Champions
[*] Greeks can place the Kastali building to create Champions
[/list]
[*] Increased the strength of all Towers
[*] Increased the damage of all Sentries in Towers
[*] Increased Tower Sentry range to match the view distance
[*] Added Norsemen Beekeeper gather animation
[*] Added Norsemen Cooper animation
[*] Added Norsemen Longhouse upgrade model
[*] Formations 'prepare' less often when moving
[*] Reduced terrain regeneration delay
[*] Display current number of free Plebs in a town
[*] Allow the number of free Plebs to be changed per town (shown when looking at each town)
[*] Slightly increased the duration for harvesting terrain
[/list]

Features:
[list]
[*] Added tree stumps and rock pebbles where Trees and Rocks have been harvested
[*] Added upgrades for all harvesting buildings which increase harvest distance and/or radius
[*] Added notification for when a player is defeated
[/list]

Performance:
[list]
[*] Add level-of-detail models for all static objects
[*] Added level-of-detail models for Grass
[*] Added setting to turn of Grass
[*] Disabled dynamic lights on lower quality settings
[*] Hide small scenery when zoomed out
[*] General render performance improvements
[*] UI animation performance improvements
[/list]

Levels:
[list]
[*] Reduces the spawn rate of all animals
[*] Minor balancing changes to some levels
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Resolved Plebs not being assigned work when they were available
[*] Ensure Plebs can always take food to houses when there is existing food
[*] Resolved saves being incorrectly loaded in many cases
[*] Resolved terrain paint and grass alignment
[*] Repaint growing terrain when loading from a save
[*] Modified how resources were requests for buildings which produce multiple output resources per input resource
[*] Corrected in-progress building UI not showing the correct number of remaining resources
[*] Limited projectile arc heights when close to their target
[*] Restore building upgrade models from saves
[*] Corrected moving house bedtimes
[*] Resolved every other unit movement request failing in some cases

[*] Resolved animals not being 'released' if the harvesting building is upgraded

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - The Norsemen
notes.content:
Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Added the Norsemen Nation
[list][*] Norsemen primarily use wood for constructing buildings and transporting food using wooden barrels, crafted by a Cooper
[*] The Norse Plebs are fed with Mead, made from the Honey produced by Beekeepers, and Dagmals, made from the Meat gathered by Hunters and Fishermen
[*] Jarls are the strongest Norsemen soldiers. Jarls will charge at their enemies, knocking them back and inflicting damage on impact[/list]
[*] Spartans get stronger when there are other Spartans in close proximity while fighting
[*] Spartans require an 'Olive Bowl' to be created by the Agoge Camp
[*] Towers can have soldiers assigned as 'Lookouts' who increase the sight range of the Tower
[*] Towers can have soldiers assigned as 'Sentries' who will attack nearby enemies with projectiles
[*] Towers with 'Garrisoned' units will increase the defensive strength of the Tower
[/list]

Features:
[list]
[*] Decreased the tooltip hover time to display
[*] Increased the tooltip text size
[*] Display on the level selection menu if a level has been completed
[*] Display an icon for buildings that cannot produce any more resources because their output resource stacks are already full
[*] Added a notification for buildings which have not had a worker allocated to them
[*] Added a notification for harvester buildings when they have not found anything to harvest in a while
[/list]

Levels:

[*] Added the 'Spread' level
[*] Added the 'Target Practice' level

[*] 'Plataea Plains' Player 3 is now Norsemen
[*] 'The Ear' Player 1 is now Norsemen
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Resolve 'Building under attack' notification not showing

[*] Corrected cases where soldiers could attack an enemy but wouldn't
[*] Resolved some cases where save games were not restored correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Small bug fix update
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who has played Plebs so far! Here are the changes contained in Plebs Version 1.0.1

Features:
[list]
[*] Implemented additional "Map Movement" options:
[list][*] "Map Grab", when the Middle mouse button is held down, the map location under the mouse is grabbed and is moved to the current mouse location
[*] "Map Pan", when the Middle mouse button is held down, the map will pan in the direction of the mouse cursor relative to its starting position
[*] "Keyboard", the 'WASD' and arrow keys can be used to pan the map[/list]
[*] Added feedback for when moving a unit fails
[*] Improved Notification spacing for long messages
[/list]

Bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Resolved a number of shader issues causing the game to not run on SteamDecks (and likely other hardware)
[*] Resolved crash when error messages were displayed
[*] Resolved a memory leak in the UI which caused crashes when the game was running for long periods
[*] Corrected Shadow 'Off' graphics setting to actually turn shadows off
[*] Corrected changing resolutions causing incorrect rendering, primarily the water
[*] Corrected changing fullscreen causing the UI to render incorrectly
[*] Fixed soldiers not garrisoning in Towers
[/list]

notes.title: Plebs has released for Early Access!
notes.content:
Today is finally the day [b]Plebs[/b] has been released for Early Access!

I already have the next Nation in development which I hope to release in the next couple of months. The update will contain another fully playable Nation plus a new Campaign


With this release the play-test has been closed - during the play-test a few changes were made:

[list]
[*] A 'Help' page has been added which has an overview of the basic features of Plebs, and can act as a starting point for new players looking to find their way in the game.
[*] The help page can be opened with the 'H' key, or by clicking the button by the minimap.
[*] Resolved a crash that sometimes occurred when first loading a level
[*] Fixed the AI behaving slightly differently when a level was loaded a second time in some cases
[*] Resolved some crashes when loading save files
[*] Better handle cleanup of some objects when returning to the main menu
[*] Resolved the AI not being able to harvest all of their resources in some levels
[*] Resolved Plebs not being able to carry resources that harvester buildings place close to the edge of their land
[*] Stop the AI from attempting to place buildings too far away from their land, or too close to enemies
[/list]
